ns2:section.sectionText: For decades now, the field of material cultural studies has offered new ways of approaching the humanities by calling attention to the complexity of our interactions with the physical world and with everyday objects. This seminar considers some of the consequences of material cultural studies for art history by examining a number of recent studies. No background in material cultural studies is necessary, but some previous coursework in art history would be helpful. This course fulfills the seminar requirement for Art History majors and minors. Open to Juniors and Seniors, or with permission of the instructor. ARTH 395 prerequisite is only recommended, not required.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to History of Art or Art History or Art and Art History major(s) or minor(s).
